fusions.name: Royal Decree
fusions.desc: Casts a commanding bolt that deals 26 damage. When it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Banner Sweep
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you takes 12 damage and is knocked back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rallying Thread
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour is 8% higher.
